title: Signal: npm client prefers cached metadata over the registry
scope: A .npmrc file that declares a client setting that reuses cached package metadata instead of asking the registry.
limitations: It matches a client setting that reuses cached package metadata instead of asking the registry in the parsed .npmrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A .npmrc that mentions a client setting that reuses cached package metadata instead of asking the registry in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
